Welcome to Pelican Grill located at the SanRoc Cay Marina!At Pelican Grill, we offer an unforgettable dining experience with our exquisite Gulf Coast cuisine. Nestled in the heart of Orange Beach, Alabama, our seafood restaurant is perfect for family-friendly dining and enjoying local favorites like shrimp baked potato, charbroiled oysters, and chicken tenders. There's something for everyone to love.Tipsy PelicanOYSTER AND DAIQUIRI
PATIO BARLive music see Facebook for band schedule.EXQUISITE SEAFOOD CUISINE & COCKTAILS

 
 
 

Indulge in the finest Gulf Coast flavors at Pelican Grill, where every dish is crafted to perfection! Our dinner menu showcases a tantalizing selection of local favorites, from lobster tails to seared tuna salad and flavorfully seasoned snow crab legs, ensuring an unforgettable experience for seafood lovers. Complement your meal with one of our expertly mixed cocktails, designed to enhance every bite. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or celebrating a special occasion, Pelican Grill offers the perfect blend of delicious food and a vibrant atmosphere. Join us and savor the ultimate coastal dining experience that will keep you coming back for more!DISCOVER OUR MENULocations + Opennig HoursVISIT US TODAY,
FOR AN UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE

 
 
 

Experience the best of coastal dining at Pelican Grill in Orange Beach! From the moment you arrive, you'll be welcomed with warm hospitality and the irresistible aroma of Gulf Coast cuisine. Indulge in a diverse dinner menu featuring local favorites like charbroiled oysters Rockefeller, hand-breaded grouper fingers, and succulent snow crab legs, all crafted with the freshest ingredients. Whether you're savoring a meal with family, celebrating a special occasion, or simply treating yourself to a night out, Pelican Grill offers a vibrant atmosphere and exceptional flavors that will leave a lasting impression. Don’t miss out on creating unforgettable moments—come and experience the finest Orange Beach dining todayADDRESS27267 Perdido Beach Blvd.
Orange Beach, AL, 36561
(251) 483-3665OPENING HOURS7 DAYS A WEEK

11AM - 9PMTASTE THE FRESHEST CATCH

 
 
 

At Pelican Grill, where we bring the flavors of the Gulf Coast right to your table in Orange Beach, Alabama! Our seafood restaurant prides itself on offering an array of local favorites, from succulent gulf shrimp offerings and our renowned blackened grouper. Experience family-friendly dining in a welcoming atmosphere, where you can indulge in dishes like fried green tomatoes and charbroiled oysters. Plus, if you have a catch of your own, we’ll fry it up to perfection just for you! Join us for a memorable meal and discover why Pelican Grill is a beloved destination for seafood lovers.EXPLORE OUR OFFERINGSENJOY PELICAN GRILL IN THE COMFORT OF YOUR HOME

 
 
 

Whether you're enjoying a night out or bringing the taste of the coast home, Pelican Grill has you covered! Indulge in our charbroiled oysters Rockefeller, hand-breaded grouper fingers, or succulent snow crab legs for a memorable dinner experience. Prefer to stay in? Our delicious takeout options let you enjoy the same quality and freshness from the comfort of your home. From shrimp baked potatoes to blackened grouper, our menu offers something for everyone to savor. Perfect for family gatherings, special occasions, or a cozy night in, Pelican Grill delivers the best of Orange Beach dining—wherever you choose to enjoy it!ORDERWHAT OUR GUESTS ARE SAYING
